subject: Convertible credit + usage accelerator proposal for Nebula Analytics
messages:

Cc: procurement@nebulaanalytics.com
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot economics + discounts for Nebula POC

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost profile looked promising for our inference workloads. Procurement asked me to get a clearer picture on economics for a 3-month POC and what discounts Terraform-style (per-token) we could expect if we convert to a committed monthly spend after the POC.

Specific asks:
- Pilot: 3 months, expected burn ~6M tokens/month (chat + embeddings). Any starter credits you can provide?
- Post-POC: We want pricing tiers and a simple example of how credits apply if we commit to 6 or 12 months.
- Legal: procurement would like a redlineable MLA earlier rather than later.

I've attached our usage projection (Nebula_POC_usage_projection.xlsx). Can you share an initial commercial outline we can take in parallel to internal reviews?

Appreciate it — Alicia

Alicia Ramos

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-05T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot economics + discounts for Nebula POC

Alicia — great to hear the demo aligned with your needs. Quick proposal below (pilot -> commit) that balances speed-to-launch with predictable unit economics. I kept numbers simple; we can convert to line-item pricing in the MLA.

Key commercial outline (proposal):
- Pilot (3 months): 60k USD in convertible credits applied to Hosted API usage. Credits cover up to 3 months of expected burn (~6M tokens/month), redeemable during pilot.
- Convertible credits: If Nebula signs a committed plan within 45 days after pilot end, unused pilot credits convert to an invoice credit and count toward the first committed invoice. If there is no commitment, unused credits expire.
- Commit tiers (per-token discounts off list):
  * Tier A: 0-20M tokens/mo — list price
  * Tier B: 20-80M tokens/mo — 10% per-token discount
  * Tier C: 80M+ tokens/mo — 18% per-token discount + optional dedicated routing
- Commitment duration: 6 or 12 months. 12-month commitments get an additional 5% multiply on the tier discount (so Tier C -> 23% for 12m).
- Usage accelerator: for the first 3 months post-commit, we offer an extra 15k USD credit if monthly usage grows >50% vs pilot baseline.
- SLA add-on and enterprise support priced separately; we can include Dedicated capacity at an uplift if you require isolation.

Attachments: I added a draft MLA and a simple example calculator (Draft_MLA_Nebula_Redwood.pdf, Nebula_POC_usage_projection.xlsx).

Next steps:
1) If this looks directionally right, procurement can sign the NDA/redline the MLA and we can issue pilot credits.
2) I’ll loop in Dev (cc’d) for a quick ops/infra alignment call if you want to validate region/throughput.

Happy to jump on a call tomorrow to walk through the convertibility mechanics — many clients find that language helps procurement approve faster.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-12-06T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot economics + discounts for Nebula POC

Looping in for margin check and final approval.

Jonas — solid structure. A couple of commercial guardrails I want to confirm before we send final to Alicia/procurement:
- Convertible credits: we need explicit language that converted credits only count toward the first invoice and do not extend the commit term.
- Accelerator credit cliff: clarify whether accelerator is additive to converted credits or paid separately. Prefer additive but only up to 50% of pilot credit value.
- Minimum monthly spend: define a de-minimis floor for committed tiers (e.g., $5k/mo) to avoid micro-commit churn.

Laura — can you run a quick margin calc (baseline list price vs Tier C @ 18% then @23%) and confirm our blended gross margin for a 12-month Tier C commit at projected Nebula usage? Dev — confirm we can guarantee the optional dedicated routing without lengthy infra changes.

If all green we'll send a tightened commercial one-pager and DocuSign link.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-06T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot economics + discounts for Nebula POC

Marissa — margin check done. High level:
- Baseline list gross margin at expected SKU mix: ~62%.
- Tier C @ 18% -> blended gross margin ~53%.
- Tier C @ 23% (12-mo uplift) -> blended gross margin ~49%.

With accelerator credit (15k USD) and convertible credit applied to first invoice, economics still acceptable for a strategic logo given cross-sell potential. Recommend setting the minimum monthly commit floor at $7.5k to avoid micro accounts.

Dev confirmed via quick chat: dedicated routing for the expected 80M+ tokens/mo profile is feasible if we reserve a small Dedicated node; lead time 10 business days after signed commit for capacity provisioning. No infra code changes required.

I’ll draft the tightened one-pager and run it by Legal for the convertible-credit clause.

—Laura

Subject: Final commercial outline & next steps (convertible credits + commit tiers)

Alicia / Procurement — thanks for the patience while we tightened the terms. Final commercial summary below; I attached the one-page and a redlineable MLA.

Final commercial highlights:
- Pilot: 60k USD in convertible credits applied to Hosted API usage during the 3-month POC.
- Convertibility: unused pilot credits convert to an invoice credit applied to the first committed invoice if a 6- or 12-month commit is signed within 45 days of pilot end. Converted credits do not extend the commitment term.
- Commit tiers (per-token discounts): Tier B 10% (20-80M/mo), Tier C 18% (80M+/mo). 12-month commit: additional 5% discount multiplier.
- Accelerator: 15k USD credit for first 3 months post-commit if usage grows >50% vs pilot baseline; accelerator credit is additive but capped at 50% of pilot credit value.
- Minimum monthly commit floor: $7.5k USD.
- Dedicated routing: available for Tier C with 10 business days lead time after signed commit; additional fee applies (outlined in MLA).

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached one-pager and the redlineable MLA (Draft_MLA_Nebula_Redwood.pdf).
2) If acceptable, I’ll send a DocuSign envelope for the pilot credit SOW and the MLA. Link (for reference): https://docusign.com/s/abcdef123456
3) We’ll provision pilot credits immediately upon signed SOW and coordinate infra scoping with Dev.

Attachments: Draft_MLA_Nebula_Redwood.pdf (redlineable), Nebula_POC_usage_projection.xlsx

Happy to hop on a call to walk procurement through the convertibility clause — procurement usually wants explicit examples and a sample invoice line.
